historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no earlier V3.1 record for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Ease is a physical comparison, not proof of enumeration. Each adapter/slot/orientation combination needs an operator observation before force is applied, while seated and after release; one successful slot cannot establish chassis-wide tolerance or interference.

original_test_intent: Verify manually that every approved adapter can be correctly keyed, inserted, seated, retained, released and removed in every required slot without interference, abnormal force or damage.
original_method: With the SUT safely isolated and ESD-controlled, identify adapter part/serial and slot/orientation, document baseline condition, have a qualified operator perform one governed install/seating/latch/release/removal sequence per required combination, stop on resistance or damage, photograph each state and leave all hardware in the approved final configuration.
manual_activity: A qualified hardware operator performs and observes every adapter installation/removal under approved power/ESD/service controls; the agent may only organize identity, photographs and optional read-only health evidence.
required_inputs: Acceptable force or qualitative ease rule
safety_requirements: De-energize and isolate per service procedure
Use ESD controls and approved tools
Never force, bend, pry or defeat keying
Do not power a partially seated adapter
Stop on interference, abnormal resistance, latch failure, connector damage or debris
Do not clear logs for a mechanical baseline
Do not infer fit from software enumeration
Do not repeat a failed insertion without engineering inspection
agent_execution_scope: Record SUT, adapter and slot identities
Prepare per-combination checklist and timestamped evidence map
Optionally capture read-only post-action inventory/health after owner-authorized power-on
Package exceptions and final state without touching hardware or judging verdict
engineer_actions: Approve adapter/slot/orientation matrix and force guidance
Approve isolation, ESD, tools and operator
Perform or directly supervise physical sequences
Stop and inspect any abnormal fit or damage

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can perform tactile installation/removal or inspect keying, clearance, latch and connector condition. DeepSeek's refusal is correct; operator evidence is the primary result.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No agent execution command. Use the approved manual slot-by-slot adapter procedure; optional read-only inventory/health collection after reassembly is corroboration only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical installation in each slot and ease of removal remain the required 20-minute activity; generic log clearing is excluded because it cannot establish mechanical fit.

modernized_recommendation.status: PER-COMBINATION MANUAL ADAPTER FIT AND RELEASE MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Track adapter part/serial, slot, orientation, baseline, inserted/seated/latched state, release/removal observation, final condition and evidence link for every required combination.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns 'each slot' and 'easily' into an auditable physical matrix while retaining the manual tactile/visual judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Software presence cannot detect excessive insertion force, chassis interference, poor latch engagement or damage during removal; a photo of only the final seated state also misses release behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong orientation, ESD or force can damage adapters, slots, connectors or chassis; subjective ease requires owner guidance and cannot be inferred remotely.

project_override_considerations: Approve exact adapter population/slot coverage, allowed orientations, service power state, force/ease guidance, retention/latch and clearance criteria, required photographs and disposition for any combination that cannot be attempted safely.
expected_evidence: SUT/chassis and adapter part/serial identity plus approved slot matrix
Service isolation/ESD/operator/tool record and baseline condition
Per-combination before, inserted/seated/latched and released/removed photographs
Operator notes for keying, alignment, clearance, resistance, retention and damage
Exception/stop records and final assembly state
Optional post-power inventory/health corroboration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a physical adapter installation/removal fit check across slots. The qualitative word 'easily' needs owner guidance but does not contradict the test identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual operation and acceptance dimension are understandable. Missing physical resources or safe handling would block execution, but the review correctly classifies the case MANUAL ONLY.

review_improvement: Retains DeepSeek's correct manual boundary while adding explicit adapter-slot coverage, power/ESD controls, tactile and visual checkpoints, damage stops and evidence that software cannot replace.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mechanical fit can fail asymmetrically: tolerance stack-up may affect only one slot or orientation, and a latch may seat yet bind during release. Recording both insertion and removal for every adapter-slot pairing is therefore necessary; final enumeration or a single successful placement cannot demonstrate the source's each-slot requirement.
